notes.title: CARRUMBLE new Arena: Space Station
notes.content:
With this weeks update we are bringing outer space to CARRUMBLE! You can now fight every single mode in this new arena, fighting against force fields, asteroids and even a disappearing floor!

New challenges to show not only to the world who is the best CARRUMBLER of the entire galaxy!


[previewyoutube=QGCRltDcoOA;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bacon joins the roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of [b]CARRUMBLE! Bacon[/b] is the fastest pig on earth. He has been working as an acrobatic pilot for all his life. His fame has reached every corner of the world... and has even surpassed that of the "Flying Elephant!". But times are changing and Bacon, afraid to be forgotten, has decided to join the "CARRUMBLE League" to keep his name among the stars. 


[previewyoutube=vEqXNI1G70Y;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ultimate Rumble is the new Mutator in today's patch!
notes.content:
With today's patch we are bringing total mayhem to [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]. In order to do so we are adding a new mutator that let's you abuse the use of your special moves! Just join in any game with the [b]Ultimate Rumble[/b] mode on and just spam your ultimate but watch out as everyone else will also be spamming!

Are you ready to face this new challenge?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/9e46fd30c59a6f61901f0757edea53184159c1fb.png[/img]

Join our community on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/7rFW6Vz]Discord[/url] and don't forget to leave us a review here n Steam!

notes.title: Mammoth Joins the Roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]! [b]Mammoth[/b] is the king of surfers. He has been living surrounded by waves and beautiful girls for his entire life, driving all around the West Coast with his loyal minivan named Orca. Lately he discovered that participating in the [b]CARRUMBLE[/b] League he can hook even more girls than surfing so now he is an active competitor in the tournament ensuring his lifestyle continues.

[previewyoutube=mF0ak3rIw9U;full][/previewyoutube]

Join our [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/7rFW6Vz]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/3DCloudsit/?ref=bookmarks]Facebook[/url]!

notes.title: New mode unlocked: Duel!
notes.content:
In this weekly update we want you to drive down into the arena and fight head to head against one single opponent.

Choose a vehicle from our vast selection, pick your favourite skin and smash the hell out from anyone who dares to challenge you!

Duel mode is already available for free in CARRUMBLE!

[url=https://discord.gg/7rFW6Vz]Join our Discord server[/url] to leave a feedback and don't forget to leave us a review here on Steam as we continue to release new content each week for the next month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/8b8b57e150240d74283f78b3862063a12b036d87.png[/img]

notes.title: CARRUMBLE new Arena: Hell
notes.content:
Welcome to Inferno, CARRUMBLERS!
With this weeks update we have added an arena straight out of hell.  You can now join the fight and throw your enemies into the flames of inferno! Chains, lava and even a special flamethrower now await you on CARRUMBLE! What are you waiting for, climb aboard and see if you can reign over the arena from hell!  Just dont get burned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/b508679c838d9c1f75472625b788c7f048f10f21.png[/img]

[i]*Don't forget to review our game on Steam, it's really important for us![/i]

notes.title: Veronica Joins the Roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of CARRUMBLE! Veronica is the most attractive girl in the CARRUMBLE league. She is really attracted by jewels and treasures...but she likes to "earn" them by herself. Once she discovered that the CARRUMBLE League is the tournament with the richest prize in the world she soon saw it as the perfect way to realize her dreams using her skill to reject lovers.

Join us on Discord!

https://discordapp.com/invite/8C4VYkP

[previewyoutube=5OrE8x-3Q-0;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: A new mutator has been added!
notes.content:
Happy new year fellow CARRUMBLERS!

We are ready to kickstart the year with new content updates such as vehicles and liveries and much much more! Today we are adding to CARRUMBLE a new mutator: The Minefield!

Dodge the mines and their blast and pull or push your enemies into them and watch them explode in thousand pieces!

Everything comes for free as usual! Have fun!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c0c6d32d4e5e46100569549c6496c1d7ce299afd.png[/img]

notes.title: CARRUMBLE new Arena: The Mall
notes.content:
Christmas is near and we have a nice gift for you! A leap into irrationality, into the chaos of everyday life, let's make a rumble inside the Mall! Have fun guys, and happy new year!

[previewyoutube=GPy9eoaeozo;full][/previewyoutube]

You can jump in the new arena as we speak, The Mall is already available in any mode!

notes.title: Gus joins the Roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]! [b]Gus[/b] is the second son of a humble family of Farmers. While working his fields, he tells everyone that he got abducted by an U.F.O. but nobody in town believes him, his face alone is enough to convince everyone that he is just plain mad. From the day he got kidnapped (it's true!) he started participating to the CARRUMBLE tournament, but nobody knows the real reason behind this choice.

[previewyoutube=iZ8SdEwYZYU;full][/previewyoutube]

Beware of the traps on the floor and pay attention to not be pushed in the ditch!

notes.title: Butter joins the Roster!
notes.content:
A new champion joins today the roster of CARRUMBLE! [b]Butter[/b] thinks to be the most graceful girl of her town, but she's not. Her passion for pastry made her become a bit oversized to make her belief a truth. She decided to join the CARRUMBLE league in order to show to the world her graceful moves and make the people understand her true nature. You can buy her and her car in the Garage right now!

[previewyoutube=O6ISy8R0sys;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]NEW PRICES[/b]

Also today we decided to lower the freemium price for all the vehicles on CARRUMBLE! Mostly of the cars dropped from 3750 Oil to 750! More variety into the Arena! Keep sending us your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c40b8f2c5bbd24e5bbeb2b274f9443d40799db90.png[/img]


Have Fun!!

notes.title: Local Multiplayer Now Available for free!
notes.content:
We have heard your feedback from the beta and are really really happy to announce Local Multiplayer mode for [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]! Four players may now jump into the arena on the same PC and play shoulder to shoulder against each other! Bring your friends to the rumble and have fun! 

Join us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/qMnjDzy]DISCORD[/url] and don't forget to leave a review, let us know what you want to see next in [b]CARRUMBLE[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c3e3b61755e3e59e824cfeedcec97ad9a376b5cf.png[/img]

With this new update comes today a new set of patch notes, with some bug fixes and two new [b]golden skins[/b]. You can get the new liveries from the garage and those comes for free until the end of December!

[b]PATCH NOTES 1.0.2[/b]
[list]
[*] Added moveset list during first brawls
[*] Added Local Multiplayer
[*] Visual fixes
[*] New Sales
[/list]

notes.title: Domino joins the roster!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=pzCkINY4Lts;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: CARRUMBLE IS NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
Free to Play game “[b]CARRUMBLE[/b]”, the unique car fighting game, will be available from today for PC gamers to download and play.

[b]CARRUMBLE[/b] is a completely free title of online combat between players.

At launch here are six heroes to choose and fight with but many more will be arriving in the coming weeks. Also at regular intervals new arena vehicles and modes will be added, each with its own characterization, liveries and special moves.

That's not all, a free golden livery awaits anyone who participates in an online CARRUMBLE fight within one month from launch. Participants of the closed beta have also got something coming to them as each of them will receive a package of 1500 credits with which to buy new cars and / or customizations.

[b]HAVE FUN GUYS![/b]

[previewyoutube=ZRQ2NMc8cpI;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: TODAY IS THE DAY!
notes.content:
Would you like to crush your opponents? Do you want to gain glory and fame playing matches online? From tomorrow you can challenge the rest of the world with CARRUMBLE! Available exclusively on Steam with the free to play formula CARRUMBLE aim is to let you have a lot of fun with a fast paced gameplay and some lovely characters to fight with-

Tune in on November 6th to download the game and, if you attended our closed beta, a special reward awaits you!

See you tomorrow CARRUMBLERS!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/79a994054835f4c29bf979f6fa179cb9b98e5b1b.jpg[/img]

See you in the arena!

notes.title: Open Beta has begun!
notes.content:
Join the [b]CARRUMBLE Open Beta[/b] and keep your progress to the release date!

You can now try three different starting champions and Noir: the special Halloween driver!

The Open Beta comes with two different mutators, online matches 4 VS 4 and four different arenas! Pay attention to the hazzards around the maps, hit and fight your opponents and gain currency to unlock more vehicles and special skins!

Have fun guys and don't forget to send us your feedback through [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/s39gPSX]Discord server[/url]!

Have a nice Week end!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/9f578fb2e884662b24a2449b5edd5b7751200b97.png[/img]

notes.title: Carrumble Open Beta Starts Tomorrow!
notes.content:
Two weeks ago, a few fellow CARRUMBLERS had the opportunity to try [b]CARRUMBLE[/b] for the first time in a Closed Beta. We received a lot of feedback on how to improve and polish the game and we have been working hard to implement many of these suggestions. To do this we even decided to push out our launch date to the 6th of November and now we want to let you try the game one last time before the official release. From [b]25th October to the 27th[/b] everyone will have the opportunity, with an [b]Open Beta[/b], to enter the CARRUMBLE arena once more and try out both new champions and a brand new Halloween arena to fight in!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/3ff0f829ffeac5444e7b656642e96061e0c16ccc.png[/img]

So be ready to fight! [b]CARRUMBLE[/b] is coming soon!

Meanwhile don’t forget to[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/qMnjDzy] join us on Discord[/url] , and help us craft the most original free to play car brawler out there!

notes.title: We have a new release date!
notes.content:
As you may have notice we have moved our release date from today to [b]November 6th[/b]. 

We had hoped to complete CARRUMBLE by the original date but we realized that some features where just not quite where we wanted them to be so we prefer to take the additional time and ensure the maximum gameplay experience. CARRUMBLE is complete and ready to play but we will use this extra time to polish, balance and implement some of the closed beta feedback. We are confident that this will make CARRUMBLE an even more fun game to play and to watch. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/c509b2ada875b3356db813810fb144ef1d50e9b8.jpg[/img]

CARRUMBLE will be supported long term after launch with lots of new content still to be created and this delay will ensure that the launch version will be the very best version possible. 

We thank you for your continuous support and to reward you for patience we are preparing an [b]Open Beta for the weekend of October 25th[/b], where everyone will be able to judge for themselves the progress made.

For more information, stay tuned on our social media and don't forget to add CARRUMBLE to your wishlist on Steam and join us on Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35739141/79a994054835f4c29bf979f6fa179cb9b98e5b1b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Thank you for participating
notes.content:
Ehi Carrumblers,

We’ve had a lot of fun playing with you during the Closed beta test, and look forward to seeing you again on October 16th for the release of [b]CARRUMBLE[/b].
We would like to thank you all for all your feedback and suggestions as we are moving now on the final phase before polishing. We are gonna add new vehicles, new mutators and a lot of new cars with their customizations in the upcoming weeks, so please join and chat with us on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/qMnjDzy]Discord[/url] to help us refine all the new features!

Also all of you that participated in this Beta Test will receive a special founder's reward in the official game, so stay connected to learn more about!
